shorts.title: A Cassowary Has a 4-Inch Dagger on Each Foot 🦶
shorts.description:
A cassowary has a dagger on each foot. The inner toe ends in a claw up to four inches long. In 2019 a pet cassowary killed its owner in Florida after he fell near it.

shorts.title: Hippos Can't Actually Swim 🦛
shorts.description:
Hippos can't actually swim. They're too heavy to float, so they bounce along the bottom. A hippo can close its nostrils and ears underwater.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: A Moose Can Swim for Two Hours Straight 🫎
shorts.description:
A moose can swim six miles an hour, for up to two hours. Rowing away is not a plan. Moose have been seen swimming more than ten miles to reach food.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: This Snail Hunts Fish With a Cloud of Insulin 🐚
shorts.description:
This snail hunts fish with insulin. It clouds the water, and the fish's blood sugar crashes. Scientists are studying cone snail insulin for faster-acting diabetes medicine.

shorts.title: Honey Badgers Are Built to Resist Cobra Venom 🦡
shorts.description:
Honey badgers are built to resist cobra venom. A tiny change in their muscles blocks part of the toxin. The same receptor change evolved separately in honey badgers, hedgehogs, pigs and mongooses.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Which animal would you least want to annoy? 👇

shorts.title: A Komodo Dragon Can Eat 80% of Its Weight in One Meal 🦎
shorts.description:
A Komodo dragon can eat eighty percent of its own weight in one meal. Its stomach just stretches. Komodo dragons can go weeks without eating between big meals.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: Piranhas Travel in Groups Because They're Scared 🐟
shorts.description:
Piranhas don't group up to hunt. They group up because they're scared of being eaten. Only a couple of the roughly 25 piranha species are known to bark.

shorts.title: Saltwater Crocodiles Have the Strongest Bite Ever Measured 🐊
shorts.description:
Saltwater crocodiles have the strongest bite ever measured. About thirty-seven hundred pounds of force. The previous record holder was an American alligator.

shorts.title: A Blue-Ringed Octopus Bite Can Be Painless 🐙
shorts.description:
A blue-ringed octopus bite can be painless. You might not notice it. And there's no antivenom. It's small enough to fit in your palm, which is exactly why you shouldn't pick one up.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Did you know the bite might not even hurt? 👇

shorts.title: A Box Jellyfish Has 24 Eyes and No Brain 👀
shorts.description:
A box jellyfish has twenty-four eyes, and no brain. Four of its eyes always look up. In Australia, vinegar is the first aid for box jellyfish stings, then emergency help.
